_comment: What a stocked home gives back to the farm (our own touch, not FarmVille 2009). A home counts once it holds something; each home adds `amount` to its boost, and the boost stops at `cap`. `feed_chance` adds to the chance a harvest drops feed (feeds.chance_base); `golden_luck` adds to the golden-harvest luck multiplier (1 + total). Add a home here and it works, no code.
